title: Glavrick and the Tripling Pearls
story: In a sea cave lit by glowing water, Glavrick the Pearl Multiplier guards a tray of cursed pearls. Every time a pearl is touched, it splits into three, and the cave only holds so much before the rattling drives everyone out. Mr 6 ties his hands behind his cape and starts counting instead.
question: Glavrick starts with 4 pearls. Mr 6 touches the whole tray once per hour, and every pearl on the tray becomes 3 pearls. After 4 hours, how many pearls are on the tray?
solution: After 4 hours there are 324 pearls on the tray.
praise: Tripling over and over was precisely the right idea — it just needed one more hour of tripling to reach hour 4.
hint: Write the count hour by hour: start at 4 and multiply by 3 four separate times.
victory: Mr 6 showed Glavrick the number 324 and asked where exactly he planned to put them all. The monster gulped, un-touched the whole tray back to four, and took up quieter work polishing shells.
imagePrompt: A wide-eyed eel-like monster surrounded by heaps of glowing pearls in a blue-lit sea cave, with a small caped numeral 6 knight calmly holding up a chalked number instead of a sword.
